title: Announcements
description: Write announcements, schedule them and publish them to their audience.
newDescription: Saved as a draft first; nobody sees it until it is published.
emptyHint: Write the first one; it stays a draft until you publish it.

sections.audienceHint: All the criteria you choose apply together. Nothing chosen: everyone who reads announcements.

pinned.label: Pin to the top
pinned.hint: Stays above every other announcement until it is unpinned.

expiresAt.label: Expires
expiresAt.hint: Readers no longer see it from this time on. Empty: it does not expire.

audienceRoles.label: Roles
audienceRoles.hint: Only people with one of these roles. None chosen: every role.

requiresAck.label: Requires read confirmation
requiresAck.hint: Readers confirm that they have read it; the confirmation report shows who has not.
